contracts.endpoint: Task PID owns receive/destroy authority; opaque broker token carries rights. Shared VM does not transfer task ownership.
contracts.derive: derive permits equal or reduced rights; deriving SEND_ONLY from itself returns existing token. endpoint_bind comment is stricter than actual broker contract. No privilege escalation demonstrated.
contracts.closure: Task exit closes owned endpoints. After endpoint-owner Reaped, old token cannot derive or destroy successor; successor owner can derive and destroy.
contracts.restricted_channel: Handle token/generation plus RecipientIdentity(pid,incarnation,vm_generation), active Account SessionRef(id,epoch), issuer and role checks. channel_vm_exclusive requires no unreaped same-VM peer. Native borrowed group continuity is not authorized by this contract.

not_run: Original-owner exclusive endpoint/capability access after its exit
Channel generation and process incarnation reuse
Independent endpoint/capability census and exact refund observer
failure_classification: Fixture expected same-rights SEND_ONLY rederive to fail; source derive contract explicitly permits it. Corrected fixture in ipc-v2-* preserves receive/destroy denial checks. No production change.
